S.FORM: saka, tahira cingra itini, mikilim ho cingra toya,
S.PHON: saka taħira ʦiŋra itini mikiɾim ħ[o|u] ʦiŋra t[o|u]ja
S.TRANSL: 這個時候，他還在找。
At this point, he was still searching.

S.FORM: ca'ay kahemhem ku falucu', nira tu saka, tamaaw tuya, takula'.
S.PHON: ʦaʡaj kaħəmħəm ku faɾuʦuʡ nira tu saka tamaaw tuja takuɾaʡ
S.FORM: ca'ay kahemhem ko faloco', nira to saka, tamaaw toya, takola'.
S.PHON: ʦaʡaj kaħəmħəm k[o|u] faɾ[o|u]ʦ[o|u]ʡ nira t[o|u] saka tamaaw t[o|u]ja tak[o|u]ɾaʡ
S.TRANSL: 心裡不死心，想要找到那隻青蛙。
He didn't give up. He wanted to find the frog.

S.FORM: saka, mikilimay ho cingra tuya, takula' han nira.
S.PHON: saka mikiɾimaj ħo ʦiŋra tuja takuɾaʡ ħan nira
S.FORM: saka, mikilimay ho cingra toya, takola' han nira.
S.PHON: saka mikiɾimaj ħ[o|u] ʦiŋra t[o|u]ja tak[o|u]ɾaʡ ħan nira
S.TRANSL: 他還是在找他的青蛙。
He was still looking for his frog.

S.FORM: tahira itini, maarawtu nira itini i, fafaed nu ongcuy ku, kuya takula, atura wacu nira.
S.PHON: taħira itini maarawtu nira itini i fafaəɬ nu oŋʦuj ku kuja takuɾa atura waʦu nira
S.FORM: tahira itini, maarawto nira itini i, fafaed no ongcoy ko, koya takola, atora waco nira.
S.PHON: taħira itini maarawt[o|u] nira itini i fafaə[ɬ|ɮ] n[o|u] [o|u]ŋʦ[o|u]j k[o|u] k[o|u]ja tak[o|u]ɾa at[o|u]ra waʦ[o|u] nira
S.TRANSL: 此時在大磐石上他看見了他的青蛙和那隻狗。
At this point, he saw the frog and his dog on the rock.

S.FORM: ta, lipahak satu falucu' nira pakaaraw tu, na takula', itini i fafaed, nu fukeloh.
S.PHON: ta ɾipaħak satu faɾuʦuʡ nira pakaaraw tu na takuɾaʡ itini i fafaəɬ nu fukəɾoħ
S.FORM: ta, lipahak sato faloco' nira pakaaraw to, na takola', itini i fafaed, no fokeloh.
S.PHON: ta ɾipaħak sat[o|u] faɾ[o|u]ʦ[o|u]ʡ nira pakaaraw t[o|u] na tak[o|u]ɾaʡ itini i fafaə[ɬ|ɮ] n[o|u] f[o|u]kəɾ[o|u]ħ
S.TRANSL: 他非常高興看見青蛙在大磐石上。
He was glad to see the frog on the rock.

S.FORM: aluman kura takula', itini i la'enu.
S.PHON: aɾuman kura takuɾaʡ itini i ɾaʡənu
S.FORM: aloman kora takola', itini i la'eno.
S.PHON: aɾ[o|u]man k[o|u]ra tak[o|u]ɾaʡ itini i ɾaʡən[o|u]
S.TRANSL: 而在底下也有很多青蛙。
There were many frogs below.

S.FORM: icuwaay kunu nu makuay, hakiya sa'an cingra nika.
S.PHON: iʦuwaaj kunu nu makuaj ħakija saʡan ʦiŋra nika
S.FORM: icowaay kono no makoay, hakiya sa'an cingra nika.
S.PHON: iʦ[o|u]waaj k[o|u]n[o|u] n[o|u] mak[o|u]aj ħakija saʡan ʦiŋra nika
S.TRANSL: 他自言自語的說＂我的究竟是哪一隻呢？＂。
'Which one is mine,' said he.

S.FORM: ira ku ccay, tu nu niraay a, a takula'.
S.PHON: ira ku ʦʦaj tu nu niraaj a a takuɾaʡ
S.FORM: ira ko ccay, to no niraay a, a takola'.
S.PHON: ira k[o|u] ʦʦaj t[o|u] n[o|u] niraaj a a tak[o|u]ɾaʡ
S.TRANSL: 其中有一隻是他的青蛙。
One of them was his frog.

S.FORM: saka, malepettu nira ku ccay a, takula' initu kiya nu makuay, a takula'. sa'an ku falucu' nira.
S.PHON: saka maɾəpəttu nira ku ʦʦaj a takuɾaʡ initu kija nu makuaj a takuɾaʡ saʡan ku faɾuʦuʡ nira
S.FORM: saka, malepetto nira ko ccay a, takola' inito kiya no makoay, a takola'. sa'an ko faloco' nira.
S.PHON: saka maɾəpətt[o|u] nira k[o|u] ʦʦaj a tak[o|u]ɾaʡ init[o|u] kija n[o|u] mak[o|u]aj a tak[o|u]ɾaʡ saʡan k[o|u] faɾ[o|u]ʦ[o|u]ʡ nira
S.TRANSL: 於是，他抓了一隻青蛙，＂我的青蛙就是這隻了＂，他心想。
He thus grabbed one frog. 'This is my frog,' thought he.

S.FORM: malipahaktu ku, falucu' a nira a pakaaraw tu, ya takula'.
S.PHON: maɾipaħaktu ku faɾuʦuʡ a nira a pakaaraw tu ja takuɾaʡ
S.FORM: malipahakto ko, faloco' a nira a pakaaraw to, ya takola'.
S.PHON: maɾipaħakt[o|u] k[o|u] faɾ[o|u]ʦ[o|u]ʡ a nira a pakaaraw t[o|u] ja tak[o|u]ɾaʡ
S.TRANSL: 他心裡非常高興，看到那隻青蛙。
He was glad to see the frog.
